source: Star_Data/scripts/build_dust_map.py: Edenhofer et al. 2024 (A&A 685, A82; CC BY 4.0) to 1.25 kpc, Vergely, Lallement & Cox 2022 (A&A 664, A174) beyond, stitched; the galaxy model's dust takes over past the boxes
frame: Galactic, pc from the Sun: x to the Galactic centre, y to l = 90 deg, z to the north Galactic pole

to_scene.note: scene ly = matrix . (x, y, z) pc

fade_pc.note: measured share = fall(|z|, z) * (fall(r, edenhofer) + (1 - fall(r, edenhofer)) * fall(max(|x|, |y|), model_xy)); fall(v, a, b) = 1 - smoothstep(a, b, v). The 25 -> 50 pc seam is inside the measured share

sphere.note: Sun-centred: (shell, b, l) with l fastest; l from 0 in equal steps (wraps), b from -90 to 90, ln r in equal steps over r_pc; texel centres mid-step. Used within fade_pc[1] of the Sun (faded to the boxes over fade_pc), empty inside r_pc[0]; same encoding
